title: Optimality of no-dimensional bounds in Banach spaces
summary: We discuss lower-bound constructions for several no-dimensional theorems of combinatorial geometry in Banach spaces. The common mechanism is the Maurey--Pisier theorem: the supremal Rademacher type of a Banach space forces finite-dimensional \(\ell_p\)-structures, and standard-coordinate configurations in these model spaces give lower bounds for the error terms. For the Helly approximation property the relevant type is the type of the dual space.
